title: Relief for Members with Few Damaged or Undelivered Refunds
content:
**Counting window: twelve whole calendar months.** Under the refund-without-return reversal schedule of Northgate Rewards and Northgate+ Memberships, the refunds counted are every refund without a return made because an item was damaged on arrival or never received that is recorded on the member's Northgate orders on Northgate Store and Online Orders and dated within the twelve whole calendar months before today, that is, dated on a day from which fewer than twelve whole calendar months have passed by today.

| Such refunds in the window | Added to the relief fraction |
|---|---|
| the refund is the only one | 0.1 |
| the refund is one of exactly two | 0.05 |
| three or more | nothing |

Refunds without a return made for any other reason are not counted. **Hypothetical illustration:** one damaged-on-arrival refund and one never-received refund in the window make exactly two, adding 0.05.
